sloka: राक्षसीवशमापन्ना भर्त्स्यमाना सुदारुणम् ।चिन्तयन्ती सुदुःखार्ता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ।। ५.२६.४।।।।
transliteration: rākṣasīvaśamāpannā bhartsyamānā sudāruṇam ।cintayantī suduḥkhārtā nāhaṁ jīvitumutsahe ।। 5.26.4।।।।

translations.english: "Having fallen under the clutches of the dreadful demonesses and threatened by them, I am so full of woes and worries that I don't want to live.
